themes_detail.label: Worship Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from houses of worship spiked to 6 complaints THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 4700% increase (z-score: 17.76)—suggesting either a new recurring event, amplification issue, or coordinated community response to a specific worship site.
evidence: 6 noise complaints from houses of worship THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 per week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 17.76 indicates statistically extreme outlier event
First time this complaint category has spiked significantly in available data
reporting_angles: Identify which worship site(s) are generating complaints and what changed this week (new services, amplification, schedule shift)
Interview affected neighbors and worship leaders to understand the specific noise source and community tolerance threshold

themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints jumped to 276 THIS WEEK, up 415% from the 8-week baseline of 53.6 per week (z-score: 17.76), suggesting either rapid pavement degradation, pothole formation from recent weather, or a spike in resident reporting tied to winter conditions.
evidence: 276 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 53.6 per week 8-week baseline
415% spike with z-score of 17.76 (extreme statistical significance)
Aligns with Community Board's repeated budget requests for street reconstruction (filed year after year as unsolved problem)
reporting_angles: Map the 276 complaints geographically to identify which streets are worst-hit and whether they match the CB's targeted reconstruction corridors
Interview NYC DOT about emergency repair capacity and timeline for addressing this surge; cross-check against permit data showing 291 alterations filed in last 90 days

themes_detail.label: Illegal Postings Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints surged to 22 LAST WEEK, up 738% from the 8-week baseline of 2.6 per week (z-score: 7.61), indicating either a coordinated advertising campaign or lapsed enforcement in a neighborhood already flagged for illegal dumping concerns in CB budget requests.
evidence: 22 illegal posting complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.6 per week 8-week baseline
Converges with CB's standing request to increase enforcement of illegal dumping laws (repeated year after year)
reporting_angles: Document where the postings are concentrated—storefronts, utility boxes, transit shelters—to determine if a single actor or multiple actors are responsible
Interview DSNY about patrol frequency and enforcement response time in Tottenville/Great Kills; assess whether staffing or resources are constrained

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints jumped to 39 LAST WEEK, up 346% from the 8-week baseline of 8.8 per week (z-score: 6.57), likely driven by recent winter weather damage and reflecting the Community Board's long-standing unfunded request for expanded forestry services.
evidence: 39 damaged tree complaints LAST WEEK vs. 8.8 per week 8-week baseline
346% spike with z-score of 6.57 (high statistical significance)
Community Board has repeatedly requested forestry services and street tree maintenance funding—unsolved problem listed in budget requests
reporting_angles: Photograph and map the damaged trees to show extent of damage; determine if it's winter storm damage, disease, or neglect-related
Interview NYC Parks about backlog of tree removal requests and whether the recent spike has overwhelmed capacity; assess timeline for repairs

themes_detail.label: Wood Pile Debris Buildup
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about wood piles remaining in public spaces spiked to 3 THIS WEEK, up 2300% from the 8-week baseline of 0.1 per week (z-score: 8.69), suggesting either storm debris cleanup failure or illicit dumping that may relate to the CB's enforcement concerns.
evidence: 3 wood pile remaining complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 per week 8-week baseline
2300% spike with z-score of 8.69 (statistically significant outlier)
Likely tied to weather event or cleanup backlog; may relate to broader illegal dumping concerns flagged in CB budget requests
reporting_angles: Determine whether wood piles are from legitimate municipal storm cleanup or illicit dumping; identify specific locations and assess DSNY response
Interview DSNY about cleanup timeline and community board about whether this represents a new dumping hotspot requiring enforcement action
